blocks.body: A tankless unit heats water on demand. When you open a hot tap, water flows through a heat exchanger and comes out hot for as long as the tap stays open. There's no tank to keep warm overnight, so it uses less energy when the house is quiet. Its limit is flow, so it's sized for the most hot water you use at once.

blocks.h2: Is Tankless Right for Your Elmhurst Home?
blocks.intro: Many Elmhurst homes can make the switch. A few things come first.

items.body: With about 8 grains of hardness, a tankless unit needs yearly descaling or a softener.
Postwar gas lines often need to be upsized.
Tankless units can't share the old chimney.
A wall unit frees up the floor.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Elmhurst's water runs about 8 grains per gallon. In a tankless heater, minerals collect in the narrow heat exchanger and slowly reduce efficiency. Most units will show an error code or lose hot water output when scale builds up. Yearly descaling prevents that. Adding a softener can stretch the interval and protect other fixtures too.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Tankless Install
blocks.body: The unit is only part of it. Most of the variation comes from the gas line, which may need to be larger, and the venting, which has to reach an outside wall. Removing the old tank and adding isolation valves for future descaling are part of the job too. We check all of it first and give you one flat price.

items.q: How often does a tankless unit need descaling in Elmhurst?
items.answer: About once a year with Elmhurst's water, or less often with a softener.

items.q: Why does my tankless heater show an error code?
items.answer: Often scale in the heat exchanger, a dirty sensor or a venting or gas supply issue.

items.q: Will I need a bigger gas line?
items.answer: Often. We check the line and meter before quoting.
Yes. We descale, clean sensors and screens and replace failed parts.

items.q: Can I descale a tankless heater myself?
items.preview: Some homeowners do, with the right kit.
items.answer: Some homeowners do with a pump kit and isolation valves. We're happy to do it for you.
